name: Tu Hai Tereko Pata Nahi Hai Lekin Tu Hai
visual_description: Naveen Kasturia and Arunabh Kumar sitting at an audition desk parodying MTV Roadies in TVF Rowdies 9 with bottom caption.
usage_context: Used to sarcastically tell someone that they possess a certain negative or funny trait, even if they deny or remain unaware of it.

example.top_caption: Friend: 'Bhai main thoda sa bhi toxic nahi hoon'
